dataset: Symptom laterality (症狀側性) controlled vocabulary
policy: Values for a symptom card clinical_attributes.laterality. Small on purpose: laterality is one of the few attributes nearly always askable and nearly always recorded, so a large vocabulary here would be noise.

SCOPE CAVEAT (2026-08-06): left/right/bilateral/midline/unilateral_alternating are true SIDEDNESS.  is not — it describes position changing over time, which is distribution/mobility, a different axis. It is kept here as a TEMPORARY COMPATIBILITY VALUE because 遊走性 is diagnostically meaningful (風) and the pilot needs somewhere to put it.
The 15 pilot cards decide whether this splits into symptom_laterality + symptom_distribution_or_mobility. Do NOT read  as a side; a template or UI that renders it as one is wrong.

records.note_zh: 遊走性有辨證意義（風），但它描述的是位置隨時間移動，不是側性。暫置於此，待 15 張試點後判斷是否獨立成 symptom_distribution_or_mobility。
